response.overview: Souvanh, a recent university graduate, returns to his agrarian village determined to bring sustainable farming practices and a higher quality of life by reopening the village community center and by constructing an irrigation system. Namphet, the son of the owners of the village's only farming supply company, works to sabotage both Souvanh's efforts to reopen the center and Souvanh's relationship with his childhood sweetheart, Duongchai. When the community center fails to qualify for an important bank loan and a sudden storm results in an injury that places Duongchai's family at the mercy of Namphet, Souvanh turns to his father for advice and support in order to achieve his goals.
response.title: Only Love
